jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Privacy Program Engineer to own the technical core of our privacy program. We've achieved ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, and SOC 2 Type II, and we run active GDPR and CCPA/CPRA programs - now we need someone to run the machinery that keeps all of it working, and to make that machinery largely run itself. This is a privacy role with real technical depth - you'll write scripts, queries, and automation. From day one you'll own real workstreams: data subject requests, the data inventory and ROPA, hands-on privacy reviews for new vendors and features.. You'll report to our Privacy Lead and be a key owner of large portions of our privacy program, as well as the key technical expert on the privacy team. This is not a ticket queue with a title. We're a small team at a company that builds AI infrastructure, and we intend to leverage it - you'll own the direction and design of the technical systems, automations, and tools that help us meet our privacy obligations at Fireworks. This individual will work closely with the Design team to conceptualize, develop, and execute compelling graphic designs that reflect Alo’s elevated aesthetic and connection to fashion, performance, and contemporary culture. The ideal candidate possesses a strong visual point of view, exceptional typography and composition skills, and a refined understanding of how graphics translate onto physical products. This role requires a balance of creativity, technical execution, and attention to detail, with the ability to deliver innovative concepts in a fast-paced design environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Graphic Design & Development - Conceptualize and create original graphics for apparel and accessories across seasonal collections. - Develop typography, illustrations, patterns, logos, and graphic artwork that align with Alo’s design direction. - Research emerging trends across fashion, art, culture, and graphic design to inspire fresh creative concepts. - Translate seasonal themes, mood boards, and creative direction into compelling graphic executions. - Explore innovative graphic treatments, placements, color combinations, and application techniques. - Present creative concepts and refine artwork based on design feedback. Product Design & Execution - Collaborate closely with apparel and accessories design

jobs.title: Graphic Designer, Paid Creative
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW As the Graphic Designer, Paid Creative, you will report directly to the Associate Design Director and support the execution of performance-driven creative across Alo's paid media channels. The ideal candidate has a sharp eye for elevated, effective design and a strong visual understanding of the Alo brand. You are passionate about crafting impactful paid advertising campaigns and will work closely with the growth team to produce best-in-class creative. RESPONSIBILITIES Assisting in developing visual concepts, graphics, and layouts for digital advertising campaigns. Creating quick-turn, social-first video content for paid platforms such as TikTok and Meta. Designing evergreen ad creative for always-on campaigns. Adapting and resizing designs across affiliate banners and ad placements while keeping brand consistency. Partnering with the design and growth teams to execute projects within brief, timeline, and brand guidelines, incorporating feedback as needed. Keeping an eye on design and social trends and sharing ideas with the team. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in graphic design, visual arts, or a related field is preferred. 2-3 years of experience as a junior or digital designer, with a portfolio that includes paid advertising work or similar designs for digital channels. Experience creating short-form video for TikTok, Meta, or other social platforms. Familiarity with affiliate and display ad specs, and the ability to work efficiently across many sizes and format

jobs.title: HR Manager
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW The HR Manager manages the daily Human Resources functions at the Vegas Distribution Center. Reporting to the Director of HR and partnering closely with the On-Site Director of Operations and facility leadership, this role supports employees and managers throughout the employment lifecycle while ensuring HR practices align with company policies, operational objectives, and applicable employment requirements. The HR Manager leads local HR operations, employee relations, onboarding, compliance, safety initiatives, HRIS administration, timekeeping support, benefits coordination, and process improvement. The successful candidate will exercise sound judgment, handle sensitive matters with discretion, and work effectively in a fast-paced operational environment. RESPONSIBILITIES Manage day-to-day HR operations for the Vegas Distribution Center and continuously improve HR systems, procedures, and standard operating procedures. Monitor applicable federal, state, and local employment requirements; recommend policy updates; and support facility compliance. Partner with internal or external legal counsel, as directed, when complex employment matters arise. Respond promptly and accurately to employee and manager questions regarding policies, procedures, benefits, and HR programs. Lead and continuously improve the employee onboarding process to provide a consistent, organized, and high-quality experience. jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.location_raw: Beverly Hills LAND, Beverly Hills, CA (HQ-L)
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW Join Alo’s Artificial Intelligence and Data Science team and help shape the future of AI across wellness, fashion, and retail. As a Lead AI Engineer, you will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for designing, building, and scaling AI-powered products and platforms that drive measurable business impact. This role is ideal for a highly technical engineer who thrives on solving complex problems, architecting production-grade AI systems, and leading large initiatives through influence rather than direct people management. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and business stakeholders to deliver innovative AI solutions across customer experience, eCommerce, retail operations, content generation, personalization, and intelligent automation. You will play a key role in advancing Alo’s AI capabilities by driving technical excellence, evaluating emerging technologies, and helping establish best practices for building and operating AI systems at scale. RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable AI solutions that address complex business challenges across the organization. Own the technical execution of large, high-impact AI initiatives from concept through production. Architect and implement production-grade AI systems leveraging large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, machine learning, computer vision, and recommendation technologies. jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW Join our dynamic in-house legal team for the summer! As a Legal Intern at Alo you will gain invaluable hands-on experience working alongside passionate in-house legal professionals. This internship provides a unique opportunity for law students to see and assist with the practical application of law in the intellectual property, employment, real estate, corporate, and litigation spaces in a high-growth, cutting-edge business environment. jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW We are seeking a people-oriented Logistics Manager, responsible for overseeing end-to-end transportation operations in a fast-paced e-commerce and retail environment. jobs.location_raw: Beverly Hills LAND, Beverly Hills, CA (HQ-L)
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW Being a part of the Alo team as a Merchandise Allocator means owning store-level inventory through data-driven allocation that supports business goals and elevates the guest experience from studio to street. The role partners closely with cross-functional teams to translate insights into action and stay aligned with key calendar milestones and evolving priorities. It requires proactively resolving inventory gaps while identifying opportunities to improve systems and processes. Above all, the Merchandise Allocator ensures inventory health that drives sell-through, efficiency, and financial performance. RESPONSIBILITIES Monitor and analyze inventory levels across stores to ensure balance and alignment with business objectives Use data-driven insights to adjust inventory accordingly to prevent stockouts, split-shipments and overstock situations Ability to interpret data and communicate findings to work cross functionally to develop action plan Foster positive relationships with multiple cross functional teams. Keep a line of communication open to ensure alignment is met Knowing and planning accordingly to various timeline/calendar touchpoints. Understanding of business needs and ability to pivot based on shifts in priorities Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, including stockouts, overstock situations, and errors between physical counts and system records Ability to identify opportunities within system and processes Reports to Manager of Allocation – Intern

jobs.title: Senior Treasury Analyst
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW Alo is seeking a Senior Treasury Analyst to support the continued expansion of our global retail operations, with a primary focus on Europe and Asia. This role will work closely with the Corporate Treasury team, international banking partners, Legal, Real Estate, and local retail teams to support international banking and treasury activities. The Senior Treasury Analyst will support international bank account openings, the issuance and administration of bank guarantees, and cash-in-transit services. The Analyst will work independently on assigned responsibilities with general guidance from the immediate supervisor. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, hands-on treasury professional with international banking experience who thrives in a fast-paced, growing global organization. RESPONSIBILITIES Prepare complete, accurate documentation and proposed communications for the immediate supervisor's final review and submission to Legal, banks and other stakeholders, subject to existing approval requirements. jobs.title: Temp Color Assistant
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW Alo is seeking a detail-oriented Freelance Color Assistant to support our Raw Materials team for a 3 month assignment. This role is fully onsite and is ideal for someone who enjoys organization, precision, and working with product development teams in a fast-paced environment. RESPONSIBILITIES Sample & Mail Intake : Receive all color-related mail and packages, verify contents, log items into tracking tools, and ensure timely distribution to the appropriate team members. Color File Management : Organize and maintain physical and digital color files to support efficient review and decision-making by the Raw Materials and Product teams. Record Keeping : Update internal systems with accurate color data, approvals, and comments; create and update folders for new submissions and archive completed work. Color Continuity Support : Help maintain seasonal color continuity tools/cards, ensuring consistency across styles, seasons, and collections. Cross-Functional Coordination : Assist in preparing, routing, and tracking color submissions and lab dips for internal stakeholders and external partners. Tracking & Reporting : Log submissions in and out as they move between teams, keeping timelines and status reports up to date. QUALIFICATIONS Strong sense of ownership with excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Flexible, positive attitude with a willingness to support shifting priorities. Highly organized, able to handle multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Visual Lead - Avalon

The Visual Lead will work closely with Operations & Visual Managers in initiating, delegating work, and providing feedback to the team to achieve optimal results supporting total store operations. jobs.description_text: Company Overview IDMe is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with IDMe once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 175 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with IDMe at 22 federal agencies, 50 state government agencies, and more than 100 healthcare organizations. Over 600 consumer brands use IDMe to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. IDMe’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. IDMe is committed to “No Identity Left Behind” to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/ . IDMe is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings. At IDMe, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process.
